notes.title: Dev Blog / News #1
notes.content:
Before getting into the main development updates I just wanted to say thank you to everyone that has wishlisted Dark Colors so far and I'll try to make these Dev blogs a more common sight over the early access period.

[h3]THE CURRENT STATE OF THE GAME[/h3]
There's still a lot of development to be done before the first episode of Dark Colors is considered ready for release in my eyes,
and I'm hoping that by releasing the story in sections it can receive feedback by the community and get more overall polish than if I was to wait for the entire game to be 100% complete.
There also may be a short free demo before the release of the first episode. 

As for how much of the game is complete, the core gameplay features are mostly finished so more time and development can be focused towards polishing the environments and the overall style of the game.

Since the style of the game leans more towards old VHS found footage and the genre is horror, it can be easy to make the movement and interaction systems slower and sluggish to make the game feel more tense.
As I don't want to fall into that type of movement system a lot of time has been put into them to make them smoother and feel better overall since some portions of the game are fast paced and require transitioning from running to crawling in a vent relatively quickly.

As suggested by the game releasing in early access first, some systems and gameplay elements will change overtime as the game gets closer to full release. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/d31djuD.jpg[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/y775Fpd.jpeg[/img]
- work in progress environments -

[h3]IN GAME PUZZLES AND THREATS[/h3]
While this is more of a linear story driven game, there will be a lot of opportunities to break off from the story and go in your own direction while exploring the facility to find extra documents and collectables around the level

You will also encounter some "roadblocks" and threats while going deeper into the facility so keep your eyes open for anything that seems out of the ordinary. 
While you can't directly kill the threats yourself you can avoid them if your quiet enough, as most of the enemies are completely blind and sense you by your noise level. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/lHRSMOJ.jpg[/img]
- just one of the many threats you'll face in the facility - 

The facility itself has a very high level of security to keep what they where working on years prior safe, so expect some environmental puzzles to keep you engaged throughout the slower sections of the story.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/36QLESf.jpeg[/img]
- environmental puzzles - 

  [h3]SUMMARY[/h3]
While there's still a long way to go before release and the first episode is only the beginning, I don't expect any delays and expect to be releasing the first episode sometime soon. There will also be a short gameplay trailer coming to the store page soon.


Can't wait to share more with everyone in the coming months!
